title: Polynomial work linear coefficient
statement: For each natural number $k$, let $P_k$ be the low degree junta polynomial degree and let $S_k$ be the polynomial sample linear coefficient. The polynomial work linear coefficient is $S_k(P_k+2)+(P_k+1)S_k(P_k+3)+(P_k+1)(P_k+2)$.
